_comment: Human-confirmed field/venue identity across leagues. The converter NEVER auto-merges differently-named records; this file is the confirmation step. Keys: '<venue>' -> canonical venue, '<venue>|<field>' -> canonical '<venue>|<field>', or '|<field>' -> venue for a field whose own `location` is empty.
_rejected_comment: Pairs a human has confirmed are DISTINCT. Decided 2026-08-31 by Greg. The suggester matches on coordinates, but 1.0 stores ONE geocode per venue, so every field at a venue shares it and distance can never discriminate within a venue — these are that blind spot, not real duplicates. The two Azalea Cages pairs are the same artifact, surfaced only after the cages were correctly placed into Azalea Road Park: a batting cage is not a ball diamond.
